title: fix(hosted): personal-view delete and attachment remove/rename answer on a hosted tenant kernel instead of 404
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8HLrJyMR9mKwcN7row9NW91)_

Fixes #36506

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：在托管云环境里，删除个人视图、删除或重命名记录附件，从“找不到”变为正常完成；自部署环境不变。
- 为什么：这三个操作原先只挂在自部署才有的网络入口上，托管租户没有这个入口，请求落空。
- 坏了会怎样：托管环境里这三个操作回到“找不到”或“未实现”；不会越权，身份和成员校验比自部署更严。
- 需要你做什么：合并即可；云端无需改代码，下次把云端依赖的平台版本升到包含本修复的版本后生效。

## What changes

Root cause: `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id` (plugin-auth) and `DELETE` / `PATCH /api/v1/attachments/:id` (service-storage) were mounted only on the kernel's `http.server`. A hosted tenant kernel owns no socket, registers no `http.server`, and runs `AuthPlugin` with `registerRoutes: false`. The host's `createHonoApp` catch-all hands every unclaimed `/api/v1/*` request to `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()`, which had no domain for either prefix and answered `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`. The cloud host's storage bridge covers only `/api/v1/storage`, so it never reached them either.

The fix applies ruling A on #22438 to these two members of the class, the same shape #36539 gave the comment doors:

- **Spec.** `IPersonalViewDoorsService.handlePersonalViewDoor(request): Promise<Response>` types a new `personal-views` slot. `IAttachmentDoorsService.handleAttachmentDoor` is implemented by the existing `file-attachments` service beside `IFileAttachmentService`. Both members are optional.
- **One body, two faces.** `createDoorTableMember(routes, mount)` (new export of `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`) runs the plugin's own registrar on a private `HonoHttpServer` that never listens, built on first request. So the caller resolution, every refusal and every answer are the self-hosted mount's own bytes. The self-hosted mounts are unchanged and no path is mounted twice.
  - `AuthPlugin.init()` registers `personal-views` whatever `registerRoutes` says; `mountPersonalViewDoor` and the member share one `personalViewDoorDeps()`.
  - `StorageServicePlugin` hands `FileAttachmentService` an `attachmentDoors` member over `mountAttachmentRemovalDoor`.
- **Runtime.** A shared bridge (`domains/own-door-bridge.ts`) and two domains, `/personal-views` and `/attachments`, claim exactly the door shapes and forward the transport's request, body unread and re-addressed to the wire path, to the member on the REQUEST kernel's slot (`getRequestKernelService`, never the host's scoped fallback). Any other shape under those prefixes keeps `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`. No slot, or no member: a typed `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming the package that registers it. A member throw or a consumed body: a sanitised `500`, logged. No auth-gate or membership exemption is added, so on the dispatcher the doors are stricter than the self-hosted mount, never looser.
- **Ledgers.** Three `server-only` rows in `route-ledger.ts` (census 153 → 156); a new `own-row-doors-session` row in the authz conformance matrix; `check-route-envelope.mjs` audits the three new domain files.
- **Dependencies.** `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/service-storage` now depend on `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` at runtime (no manifest cycle; `check:workspace-manifest-cycles` green).
- **Surface widening** (hence `Clause-②: yes`): two new contract interfaces, a new typed slot name (`personal-views` is now taken, so a composition registering its own service under that name beside `AuthPlugin` fails to boot with a duplicate-service error), two new exports from plugin-hono-server, and two new dispatcher domains.

No cloud code change and no cloud deploy is needed. Hosted gets the fix when cloud's objectstack pin moves past this PR, as with #36469.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.test.ts` (27): `describe.each` over both families. Forwarding with the transport's own request and body unread; exact claim and misses; the environment-scoped spelling; 501 for an empty slot, a throwing lookup and a missing member; per-request reads; request kernel only (the host kernel's member is never used); member throw 500; consumed body 500; both preamble gates (membership 403, owed-step gate) with a member control.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/door-table-member.test.ts` (4): byte parity against a `HonoHttpServer` mount; unmatched 404 without building the table; built once; the matcher.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-door-member.test.ts` (3): `AuthPlugin.init` with `registerRoutes: false` registers the slot once; an anonymous request is byte-equal to the self-hosted mount's 401; a non-door request is 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-removal-routes.integration.test.ts`: a new describe with no `http.server` (no routes mounted; the uploader renames then removes, 200 each; another member 403; anonymous 401 on both doors; a GET 404).
- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-own-row-doors.conformance.test.ts` (7), the wire half: `createHonoApp` over a kernel with no `http.server`, the real `AuthPlugin` composed with `registerRoutes: false`, the real `StorageServicePlugin`, platform objects, security and sharing, and real better-auth sessions signed in through the same transport. No door answers a route miss; the owner removes their own personal view (200, row gone); another member 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` and anonymous 401 (row stays); the uploader renames then removes their own attachment (200 each, store follows); anonymous 401 on both attachment doors; the refusals are byte-identical to the self-hosted mount over a real socket; a kernel without service-storage answers 501 naming it. The subject packages resolve from source (`vitest.config.ts` aliases).
- Dogfood, real composed stack, through `HttpDispatcher` alone (`hosted-dispatcher.testkit.ts`): `personal-view-row-scope` gains a `[hosted]` describe (owner removal 200, another user 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, anonymous 401); `member-attachment-baseline` gains a `[hosted]` case (other member 403, anonymous 401, rename 200 trimmed, removal 200 and the row is gone).

## Acceptance notes

- Red before the fix, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the restore proved (`blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - the two domain registrations deleted from `http-dispatcher.ts`: `own-door-bridge.test.ts` 21 of 27 red (the 6 that stay green are the miss and gate cases, which hold without the domain);
  - `ctx.registerService('personal-views', …)` deleted: the plugin-auth member test 3 of 3 red;
  - the `attachmentDoors:` dep renamed away: the storage integration file 3 red, 17 green (the new describe's door cases).
  - The wire-half file, 7 tests: the two dispatcher domain registrations deleted and runtime `dist` rebuilt: 7 of 7 red, each answering the pre-fix `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` (restored, rebuilt, green again); `registerService('personal-views', …)` deleted: 4 red (every personal-view case and the parity case); `attachmentDoors:` renamed away: 4 red (every attachment case and the parity case).
- Overlap: `#36311` conflicts in `auth-plugin.ts`, but `origin/main × #36311` already has that one hunk (an import line). `HEAD × #36311` has the same single hunk, so it is not added by this branch. `#35129` and `#34223` merge cleanly.

## Verification

- Typecheck green: spec, runtime, plugin-auth, service-storage, plugin-hono-server, dogfood.
- Full suites green: http-conformance 22 files / 305 tests; runtime 641 files / 11872 tests; plugin-auth 294 / 6268; service-storage 88 / 1729; plugin-hono-server 44 / 585.
- Dogfood: `personal-view-row-scope` + `member-attachment-baseline` 37 / 37.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 137 derived, 136 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, needs every package's `dist/`; left to CI). `check:undeclared-dep-imports` caught plugin-auth listing plugin-hono-server as a dev dependency only; fixed and green.
- eslint on the 31 changed source files, with `--no-inline-config` as `pnpm lint` runs it, green (the whole-tree `pnpm lint` is left to CI); `check-nul-bytes` OK.
